title: The reader is always right; the writer is never blocked
body: No waits, no spins, no back-pressure.

title: Zero is a contract
body: 0 alloc/frame, 0 locks on the hot path, 0 GC scans, 0 torn reads.

title: Mechanism, not policy
body: Weft owns the channel — buffer, protocol, lifecycle. It has no opinions about what you draw.

title: Honesty is a feature
body: Every claim ships with its boundary. Non-goals are a first-class document.
